description: This file defines configuration functions and default settings for a Mattermost server, including merging configurations, environment-specific overrides, and detailed server parameters.

methods.name: getOnPremServerConfig
methods.description: Returns the combined on-premises server configuration by merging default and environment-specific settings.

methods.name: mergeWithOnPremServerConfig
methods.description: Merges the current server configuration with provided overrides to produce a customized configuration.
